notes: Portable C++ primary/contract and Java parity translate an independently green 56-assertion native HLA_EVOKED terminal timestamped directed-interaction retraction save/restore case. A published object with a directed interaction is discovered by a constrained recipient. The sender retracts one timestamped directed message and saves its terminal designator alongside a separate live admission passel. The saved handle remains MessageCanNoLongerBeRetracted after restore while a distinct post-save handle is InvalidMessageRetractionHandle. The adapter supplies the installed provider, endpoint, IEEE 1516.2-2025 FOM with a configured object class, attribute, and directed interaction class, logical-time implementation, and HLA_EVOKED callback configuration. Both portable languages select TIMESTAMP order through the standard service and construct five-epsilon lookahead through the official time API so the recipient can reach the save frontier. Seven direct requirement-section pairs cover seven clauses. Isolated portable C++ primary/contract passed against installed package libraries with HLAinteger64Time and HLAfloat64Time. Java compiles against the pinned official API-only JAR; Java provider runtime, HLA_IMMEDIATE, delivered directed callbacks after restore, durable/process-restart restore, and interoperability remain unverified. This is experimental public-API evidence, not a conformance claim.
